summary.text: Terry Canales is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 40 who has represented the district since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Terry Canales's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Transportation (chair) and Homeland Security & Public Safety.
He also chaired the Transportation Committee in 2021-2022.
